messages:
emma_cs: FYI — ACME reported that after this morning's model flip our /generate-order endpoint started returning payloads that break their JSON contract. They see numbers turned into strings and an unexpected top-level 'meta' object. Ticket: https://acme.support/tkt/3421 :eyes:

olivia_support: can you paste a minimal repro from the customer? any request + response examples are helpful.

emma_cs: their example below (redacted). they say this only started after the rollout around 11:00 UTC.
```json
// expected (contract v1)
{
  "order_id": 12345,
  "items": [{"sku": "A1", "qty": 2}],
  "metadata": null
}

// actual from our API response
{
  "order_id": "12345",
  "items": "[{\"sku\": \"A1\", \"qty\": 2}]",
  "meta": {"source": "llm", "confidence": 0.87}
}
```

raj_research: hmm — items became a stringified JSON array and the key renamed to meta. That looks like the model is outputting a different template than the parser expects. Could be a prompt/template drift or we switched to a model variant that tends to wrap arrays.

jordan_runtime: @raj_research which rollout was this? I see deploy-bot logs for 2026-03-17 11:02 UTC: canary -> stable completed.
deploy-bot: rollout id r-20260317-311 completed: canary->stable (model: redwood-llm-v2b, variant: vanilla) at 2026-03-17T11:02:08Z.

ops-oncall: priority-high, assigning to eng-runtime to triage. recency: customer is in production, hitting failures in downstream parser, they have a fallback but it's dropping orders.

olivia_support: repro steps from customer: 1) POST /generate-order with order prompt 2) parse JSON body with strict schema validator 3) validator errors on items type and missing metadata key. They shared the exact request body if needed.

raj_research: quick triage ideas: 1) check model_prompt template change in rollout config (we recently toggled 'compact-json' prompt hint), 2) examine sampling params (top_p/temperature) — if changed, can produce wrapped arrays, 3) check any postprocessing layer that attempted to coerce tokens to strings.

jordan_runtime: I'm running a local canary against the same model variant to repro. If I can reproduce, we'll roll back the stable traffic to previous variant and patch the prompt.

emma_cs: customer wants ETA on rollback or hotfix. They provided 3 failing examples and said ~0.6% of orders are failing.

ops-oncall: suggested immediate actions: 1) disable compact-json hint in model config and redeploy canary, 2) add stricter structured-output guardrail (schema-enforced post-check) on the API layer to convert or reject, 3) notify customer with mitigation steps.

raj_research: quick check: shared sample of model completion tokens shows literal brackets and backslashes around items — so model emitted escaped JSON in one token sequence. That matches stringified array. I'd prioritise changing the prompt to include an explicit 'Return native JSON only, do not stringify arrays or escape characters' and set temperature=0.

jordan_runtime: rolling a canary with config change now (disable compact-json + temperature=0). I'll post logs.
deploy-bot: rollout id r-20260317-312 initiated: canary (model redwood-llm-v2b, prompt patch) at 2026-03-17T11:18:10Z.

emma_cs: thank you — I've told ACME we'll push a fix within the hour and will follow up with a mitigation (post-check that converts stringified arrays back into arrays when safe) so they can reduce customer impact.

olivia_support: please capture failing examples in the ticket and add any diffs between expected/actual. I'll keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:

raj_research: follow-up: let's add an alert in console for structured-output drift that triggers if schema validation error rate > 0.1% post-rollout. Could have caught this earlier.

jordan_runtime: noted — creating infra ticket to add the guardrail and alerting rule.

ops-oncall: closing loop: assigned eng-runtime (jordan_runtime) + research (raj_research) + CS (olivia_support). Next update in 30m or when rollback done.

emma_cs: ACME acknowledged the plan and requested a summary when fixed. I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem after we confirm the rollback or fix. :white_check_mark:
